name: creationell-theme/related-posts
title: Related posts
description: Posts that share a category or tag with the current post, as a grid or a slider.

attributes.label: Number of posts
attributes.help: 0 uses the number of the theme settings.

attributes.label: Display
attributes.help: The slider needs the module post slider; while it is off the posts show as a grid.

attributes.label: Heading
attributes.help: Leave empty for the heading of the theme settings.

attributes.label: Heading level
attributes.help: Level of the heading, to fit the headings around the block; the post titles follow one level below.
